product.name: FitMilk Daily Protein (demo)
product.audience: Urban office workers, light-fitness users, weight-management consumers, and convenience-store shoppers who want easier daily protein intake
product.positioning: A convenience-store ready-to-drink protein milk for everyday health routines, not a bodybuilding supplement or meal-replacement shake
sellingPoints: 15g protein in a familiar chilled milk-drink format
Convenience-store availability for breakfast, office snacking, and post-workout recovery

trend.name: Everyday protein for lifestyle weight management
trend.region: China, with Japan as a reference market
trend.description: Light-fitness and weight-management consumers treat protein as a daily routine: breakfast backup, office snack, post-workout drink, or lower-sugar replacement for sweet drinks.
trend.drivenBy: Fitness content, weight-management creators, convenience-store discovery, active-lifestyle nutrition brands, and Japan-style RTD protein benchmarks
trend.format: What I drink in a calorie deficit, convenience-store protein find, breakfast in a rush, office snack swap, post-workout bottle check
trend.whyPopular: Healthier living is becoming less gym-only and more routine-based; consumers want easy protein without mixing powder or committing to meal-replacement products.
trend.exampleContent: Creator compares a normal sweet drink with a 15g protein RTD milk after a light workout or during an office afternoon slump.
trend.controversy: Protein and weight-management claims can drift into diet anxiety, meal-replacement overclaiming, kidney-health concerns for some users, or pseudo-scientific fitness marketing.
